name: Twinstripe Vigero
summary: A Standout street-racer build of the Declasse Vigero ZX Convertible that Game8 finds outside Brian's Lockup in Key Lento.
body: Game8 files the Twinstripe Vigero as a Standout vehicle of the Street Racer type, made by Declasse and dated to the 2010s.
Game8 describes it as a Vigero ZX Convertible tuned for racing and given a custom paint scheme.
Game8 says it has a fixed spawn outside Brian's Lockup on Sunset Dr., on the southwest side of Key Lento; if it appears with the roof up, a window has to be broken to get in.
Game8 says it cannot be driven until the Clone Key option is unlocked during Chapter 3 of the story.

Game8 rates it 7.1 for speed and acceleration, 5.6 for asphalt handling, 3.4 off-road and 3 for strength, with base ratings of 656 on asphalt and 219 off-road; it seats two, holds two items and uses the Muscle mod specialist.

facts.availability: Fixed spawn outside Brian's Lockup, Sunset Dr., Key Lento; needs Clone Key (Chapter 3)

name: Driveshaft Hustler
summary: A Standout hot-rod conversion of a '32 Vapid Hustler parked at a wealthy home in southeast Key Lento, per Game8.
body: Game8 files the Driveshaft Hustler as a Standout vehicle of the DriveShaft Famous type, made by Vapid and dated to the 1930s.
Game8 describes it as a carefully kept '32 Vapid Hustler turned into a hot rod, owned by an elderly Key Lento resident named Tommy O'Callahan.
Game8 says it spawns in the front yard of a wealthy house on the southeast side of Key Lento, just east of Jeb's Snack Bar on Dolphin Dr.

Game8 rates it 4 for speed, 5.7 for acceleration, 3.3 asphalt handling, 3.8 off-road and 3 strength, with base ratings of 447 on asphalt and 258 off-road; it seats two and its mod specialist is Hot Rods.

facts.availability: Fixed spawn at a house east of Jeb's Snack Bar, Dolphin Dr., Key Lento

name: Albany Teniente Manana
summary: A Standout lowrider built from a '77 Albany Manana, kept by the M7 gang in a garage at the Nova Auto Junkyard in Hamlet.
body: Game8 files the Teniente Manana as a Standout vehicle of the Lowrider type, made by Albany, and calls it a luxury lowrider converted from a '77 Albany Manana.
Game8 and IGN both place it at the M7 gang's Nova Auto Junkyard in Hamlet; IGN says it is the third Key Valuable of that Illegal Operation, sitting in the garage beside the office with the safe.
IGN says the car is unlocked with no trackers, costs $1,450 to register and sells for $3,770.
The sources differ on its type: Game8 lists it as a Lowrider, while IGN calls it a muscle car.
Game8 rates it 4.8 for speed, 5.2 acceleration, 4 asphalt handling, 2.6 off-road and 3 strength, with base ratings of 475 on asphalt and 182 off-road.

facts.availability: Key Valuable at the M7 Nova Auto Junkyard, Hamlet

name: Vapid Cultivator Sandking
summary: A Standout Sandking truck that IGN finds parked inside the Industrial Weed Grow operation in Mariana County.
body: IGN calls the Vapid Cultivator Sandking a Standout vehicle and the first of three Key Valuables at the Industrial Weed Grow Illegal Operation.
IGN says it sits in the middle of the operation's large warehouse and that the north side of the building has an opening straight to it.
IGN says the truck is unlocked with no alarm, costs $6,300 to register and sells for $16,170.
IGN does not say which Standout group it belongs to.

facts.availability: Key Valuable at the Industrial Weed Grow, North Mariana County
